goal: NEXT_GOAL.md: G3.1 证据补强与全仓复核 -> Gate A 验收与 W17 结果系统推进

audit_review_conclusion.historical_phase4_1_assessment: Historical phase4_1_acceptance.json claimed PASS, but semantic review identified required coverage gaps and insufficient reopen verification (F01-F06). Specifically: W13_T006 was left as IMPLEMENTATION_GAP; reopen checks relied on constant 300K/293.15K boundary values instead of non-boundary stored solution fields; DispatchWitness allowed silent mutator misclassification (F04); and envelope danger flags could be masked by outer false (F05).
audit_review_conclusion.gate_a_resolution_status: All Gate A requirements (A1, A2, A3) have been formally resolved and verified with dedicated test suites and evidence.
audit_review_conclusion.historical_evidence_preservation: evidence/phase4_1_acceptance.json and original run transcripts are preserved byte-for-byte without overwrite.

A1_F04_dispatch_witness.description: Refactored is_mutation_call with signature/argument analysis; pure getters separated from mutator overloads (label, active, lengthUnit); selection mutations (all, named, inherit) strictly classified as mutators; unknown methods fail-closed as UNKNOWN/MUTATION. DispatchWitness captures command, receiver, method, args across RemoteJava, code_compile, code_execute, and modelutil.

A1_F05_danger_signal_escalation.description: classify_envelope and _merge_contract_envelopes strictly escalate danger booleans (execution_state_unknown, cleanup_failed, partial_change, engine_state_unknown: True > None > False). Outer False or success cannot mask inner danger. Status severity hierarchy enforced.

A2_F03_dataset_binding_accessor.description: Replaced __call__() probe on Java DatasetFeatureList with collection.get(tag) standard accessor. _evaluation_binding verifies solution link and sets binding_complete=False when solution association is missing.

A2_F01_F06_w13_t006_variables.description: Created both component variable group (comp1) and global variable group. Each defines two variables with inter-variable dependencies (q1=2, q2=q1*3; g1=5, g2=g1*4). Modified variables (q1=4, g1=10). Verified varnames without bogus name/expr. Evaluated global dependent expressions (g1=10.0, g2=40.0) and verified component scope separation.

A2_F02_identical_sha_reopen.description: Chain A/B/C reopen verified against exact SHA256 stored solutions without re-solving: Chain A compares 3 non-boundary temperature points (308.15, 323.15, 338.15 K) and heat flux; Chain B verifies 3 distinct times and 3 spatial points; Chain C verifies modified continuation model settings, solver tuning, and derived values. Four negative controls verify checker sensitivity to cleared solution, corrupted values, SHA mismatch, and missing derived values.
